title: Event-driven pipeline
about: An order pipeline of three Lambda functions: `POST /orders` puts an order on an SQS FIFO queue with a dead-letter queue, a consumer processes it one message at a time and publishes an `OrderProcessed` event to an EventBridge bus, and a third function is triggered by that event. Each function imports a different AWS SDK client or none.
changesFromStarter: Every direct dependency is pinned to an exact version, the newest within the starter's own range.
